consequence.statement: The new optional spec.signatureAlgorithm field enables certificate signature algorithm configuration but does not affect existing Certificate resources that do not set this field.

original.statement: A new optional field spec.signatureAlgorithm is added to the Certificate v1 schema in cert-manager.io.

decision.reason: The v1.18.0 CRDs [ev-9b6164ce0df7] add spec.signatureAlgorithm to the cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate schema, which the v1.17.0 CRDs [ev-60054fcf0986] lack. Validators confirmed this as a pure addition. The canonical added/none rule also confirmed that a newly added field has no consequence for existing environments. Nothing in the evidence shows a removal, stricter validation or a default change that would justify a review or action kind, so "none" (informational) is supported.
